US Midterms: Survey Shows Declining Support Among Indian-Americans for Trump

A survey indicates a decline in support for Donald Trump among Indian-Americans ahead of the US midterm elections. The coverage also touches upon broader themes within the US political landscape, including identity politics, the impact of trade wars on Republican campaigns, and challenges faced by Democrats in California. Additionally, reports mention Republicans seeking to block a campaign advertising ruling and a watchdog finding that IRS audit revenue has plummeted under Trump.
